{{Top|leg}}
'''Airscoops''' were vehicle mounted devices with a variety of uses. The [[Tondra clan]] used the airscoops attached to the front of [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] to harvest [[algae]] from the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> [[Barimoq Industries]] fitted their [[steam rover]]s with airscoops that separated, compressed, then replaced [[Gas/Legends|gases]] such as [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] and [[Helium/Legends|helium]] that the vehicle's [[steam turbine]]s ran on.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
